issues.problem: Two reviewers disagree on whether Ananya's left or right hand is on top. The current record says left over right. My reading of the fingertip direction suggests right over left. docs/ART-QUALITY.md requires that, when reviewers' left/right judgements conflict, a separate check of the actual image settles it, looking at which face of the hand is visible and the forearm-to-wrist path, before the record can pass. Two ways to resolve it: (a) confirm at 200% in quality-plan, tracing each wrist to its sleeve, and keep or flip the record with that reason saved; or (b) since the hand order carries no story meaning, make the record neutral ('both hands folded together on the desk, overlap order not specified') and record why.
